method_notes: rule_file_sha256 is SHA-256 over the exact bytes of each research/readiness/type-rules/TR-*.json at review time. A changed file is not covered by this review.

quote_exact: quoted_clause is an exact substring of source.text_path (UTF-8). text_hash_verified: SHA-256 of that file's UTF-8 text equals source.text_sha256. For all 21 rules with a source, both checks passed, quoted_parts equals [quoted_clause], and the quote sits at exemplar.char_start..char_end and occurs once.

Each exemplar text was read in full, to judge whether the quote is the exemplar's own operative text and whether the exemplar is a true member of the type (not a modification order, an outlier subtype or a neighbouring order).
Legal propositions were checked by web search; 41 Stat. 1359-1360 was read from govinfo. Points the reviewer gives from memory are marked 'verify'.

This is an independent AI review of research PATTERNS. It is not human certification, decides no order, fills no claim field, changes no status, and leaves the 0 human-certified whole-lifecycle count unchanged. Rules marked approve_with_required_changes are not frozen as reviewed until revised and re-reviewed (new file hash).

Common weakness across rules: exceptions_savings.reviewed is false everywhere. Several land rules lack the FLPMA s.701 savings note. Several exemplars are amending or modifying orders, whose lifecycle follows a parent order.

Correct the IRA statement. Section 2 (48 Stat. 984) provides that existing trust periods 'are hereby extended and continued until otherwise directed by Congress', but s.13 excludes listed Oklahoma tribes from s.2, and s.18 makes the Act inapplicable to reservations that voted to exclude themselves. For excluded reservations, the Act of June 15, 1935 (s.3) extended trust periods to Dec. 31, 1936, and later extensions followed. So s.2 is not a uniform end for extension orders.
Replace 'each extension order is superseded by the next': a later extension usually runs from the earlier order's expiration date. The earlier order ends on its own stated date and is not superseded.

Allotments made inside the reservation, which have separate trust lifecycles.

required_changes: Correct the description of the 1921 resolution. Pub. Res. 64 of March 3, 1921 (41 Stat. 1359-1360) does not apply to 'Acts it names'. It operates generally on any provision contingent on the duration or termination of the war or the 'present or existing emergency', and on any Act in force only during the war (or the war plus a limited period). It names exceptions: Title 2 of the Food Control and District of Columbia Rents Act, the Trading with the Enemy Act and amendments, the Liberty Bond Acts and Victory Liberty Loan Act, Titles 1 and 3 of the War Finance Corporation Act, Pub. Res. 55, and proclamations under the excepted Acts. Rewrite ending_pattern and outlier_conditions to match: 'orders whose authority is not war- or emergency-contingent by its terms' and 'orders under the excepted Acts'.

State that the resolution ends the war-contingent statutory authority, not each order automatically. Orders whose effects were performed or vested (for example, corporations created) survive as accrued effects.
